items.name: gummy-base
items.title: Gummy UI Base
items.description: Gel Pop semantic tokens and light/dark theme architecture.

items.name: gummy-button
items.title: Gummy Button
items.description: Accessible fruit-gel Button with chewy press physics and high-transmission finish.

items.title: Gummy Core Component Material
items.description: Shared canonical material, responsive states, RTL, dark theme, and reduced-motion styles for the seven approved benchmark components.

items.name: gummy-input
items.title: Gummy Input
